paragraphs.text: Tetzin is a legendary gnome from Ixalan .

Tetzin is a character that debuted in The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander as an additional card within set and collector boosters but not from any of the commander decks. They are a gnome from Ixalan's Core and can combine with other artifacts to become the Golden-Gear Colossus , which Tetzin serves as the head of.
